[Page context: the user has the Policy Service record "00002609: Moving to a new home in Belvidere" open (object Case, Id 500aj00003jfwUXAAY). "This", "here" and "this policy service" refer to that record.]

Close this request and note on the file that the customer confirmed the change by phone.

I've set up both changes. Neither happens until you press Confirm. Before you close it: the rewrite task for the Belvidere address is still open and due Oct 11, and the last note says the closing date and the lender's mortgagee clause hadn't come in yet.
Shown to the user as a card with Confirm and Cancel buttons. Nothing has been written. It is saved only if they press Confirm; an App note in a later message will say what they did.
